FeinwerkDashboardSharing.SupportTitle: Opens the Feinwerk contact form in a new tab
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.PromoCampaignsText: UTM builder and naming conventions for your team, so that campaigns arrive in Matomo cleanly.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.PromoHostingText: Feinwerk runs your Matomo instance in German data centers, with updates, backups and monitoring, and the move is included.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.PromoCapiText: Feinwerk Conversions API sends orders and goals from Matomo server-side to Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X and Microsoft Advertising, only with consent and without ad pixels on your website.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.PromoSentinelText: The free plugin Feinwerk Sentinel watches your Matomo data around the clock and alerts you by email, Slack or Teams as soon as goals stop or tracking breaks.
